overwhelm i guess. like theres too much and not enough of me. every morning i wake up already behind

flooded. like the dishes are still in the sink from two days ago and theres laundry on the chair and my mom keeps calling and i havent called her back and i just stand in the kitchen and cant pick where to start

freeze. completely. i just scroll my phone instead and then hate myself for it because now its even later and nothing got done. and then the whole cycle again tomorrow

the hating myself part. because i KNOW its not even that much. like its dishes. its a phone call. people deal with way worse and just do it. why cant i just do it. whats wrong with me

shame probably. like its not just im tired its that im failing at being a person. my mom calls and i let it ring because i dont have anything good to tell her. i dont want her to hear me like this. shes already worried about me
